🌊 SIDS have consistently shown resilience and leadership in protecting their unique cultural and geographic heritage through bold commitments and strong political will, including pledges by many to achieve 100% renewable electricity by 2030.

At @COP29 in Azerbaijan, @UNDP and @AOSIS joined forces to host a session that provided a platform for discussing and positioning actionable opportunities to operationalize the priorities of the ABAS declaration, focusing on how to accelerate a just energy transition to unlock development opportunities in SIDS.

Key action steps to advance the energy-for-development pathway in SIDS: 

1. Advance a just energy transition to unlock transformative development across key sectors such as e-mobility, sustainable tourism, urban agriculture, and fisheries – tailored to the needs of each island community. 🏝️🚌
2. Leverage digital innovation to transition from traditional centralized systems to smart grids and digital platforms that optimize local electricity networks, enhancing resilience and efficiency, particularly in regions prone to natural disasters. 🌱
3. Scale financial mechanisms like debt-for-nature & energy swaps, blended finance funds, and National Laboratories of Financial Innovation to mobilize the capital needed to reach the $5.9 USD billion annually to meet their renewable energy target by 2030.  💡

@UNDP, in partnership with @AOSIS, has introduced a strategic approach addressing the ABAS declaration, detailed in our policy brief, “Advancing a Just Energy Transition in SIDS.” Presented during the event, this paper outlines key sustainable energy opportunities for the next decade of development in SIDS, to drive equitable economic growth and enhance resilience for integrated human development. ⚡️
